summary: Loma Negra filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2Q26 earnings presentation and conference call materials. The filing contains routine quarterly financial results, forward-looking statements, and IFRS/IAS 29 disclosure notes, with no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The registrant is simply reporting earnings as a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, board actions, or transaction mechanics are present. This is an ordinary earnings-related 6-K and does not constitute a special situation.
